Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFValidationReportItem

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFValidationReportItem
public class CPDFValidationReportItem extends Object
One check result inside a CPDFSignatureValidationReport, or an error or warning returned by CPDFLtvService.

Every item carries a stable, category-scoped code such as "integrity.valid", "certificate.chain.trusted", "timestamp.embedded.imprint.valid" or "pades.baseline_lt.valid". Codes are the contract to program against; message is a human-readable description.

Instances are created from native code; all fields are read-only.
